papers.title: Certificate Realization
papers.current_ceiling: The split bounded results remain the admissible ceiling: alphabet-Davenport normal form and certificate-complexity versus intrinsic-support separation.
post_matrix_updates: The August 29 branch sweep recovered the V3 bounded-closeout evidence package without treating its placeholder SHA256SUMS as a custody receipt.
load_bearing_adverse: The executed contextual-move successor reached T1_QUOTIENT_REPAIRS_COMPLETENESS_ONLY.
Quotient completeness does not prove source completeness.
The old Round-3 outcomes are derivation/adverse history and cannot be reused to rescue the same claim.
papers.strongest_remaining_gap: The missing object is a necessary-and-sufficient lifting theorem from quotient moves to source-level contextual reachability, or a minimal obstruction proving that no finite source basis can exist under the stated semantics.
papers.decisive_question: Is source-level completeness equivalent to quotient completeness plus fibre connectivity and context-stable liftability, and which of those conditions holds for the ORION-01 realization map?
papers.maximum_claim_if_supported: A characterization theorem that precisely separates when quotient certificates can and cannot be realized by source-level contextual moves.
papers.hypothesis_or_theorem: For a source rewrite graph S, quotient graph Q and projection pi:S→Q, prove that source reachability is generated by lifted quotient moves exactly when every pi-fibre is connected by kernel moves and every quotient generator admits a context-stable lift; then decide both predicates for the ORION-01 system.
papers.population_or_universe: All admissible source objects and contexts under the current formal semantics; bounded exhaustive instances are a validation layer, not the theorem statement.
papers.unit_of_analysis: A source-state pair, quotient edge or projection fibre.
historical_only_inputs: All prior Round-3 and contextual-move outcomes
design: Write the abstract lifting theorem independently of ORION-specific notation.
Mechanize the forward and reverse directions, including the failure case where a fibre is disconnected or a quotient edge has no stable lift.
Instantiate the theorem on the canonical ORION-01 source/quotient definitions.
Use exhaustive small-instance search only to find counterexamples or validate the mechanized statement, never as a substitute for the unbounded proof.
baselines: Minimal donor rewrite basis from the nearest algebraic literature.
primary_endpoints: Proof status for both directions of the lifting equivalence.
Existence and minimal size of disconnected-fibre or non-liftable-edge witnesses.
Kernel-move basis size and certificate complexity.
negative_controls: Quotient generator that lifts only in one context.
Identity projection, which must collapse the theorem to ordinary reachability.
analysis_plan: Primary result is theorem/counterexample, not an empirical p-value.
Any finite census reports exact universe, solver completeness and proof-certificate validation.
Novelty is assessed against primary-source rewrite-system and lifting results before claim promotion.
papers.power_or_exhaustion_rule: Mechanized proof for the general statement; if an ORION-specific finite case remains, exhaust the full prospectively pinned universe rather than sample it.
papers.success_gate: Both equivalence directions are kernel-checked, the ORION-01 predicates are independently replayed, and no counterexample survives the exhaustive bounded falsifier suite.
papers.refutation_gate: A minimal disconnected fibre, unstable lift or source pair reachable in Q but not in S falsifies the proposed completeness route and becomes the publishable obstruction theorem.
papers.cannot_check_gate: CANNOT_CHECK if source semantics, context action or projection are not frozen unambiguously, or if proof objects cannot be replayed in an independent kernel.
papers.authority_required: Machine-checkable proof plus an independently implemented finite checker; a primary-source novelty audit is required before any first-of-kind wording.
freeze_before_outcome: Definitions of S, Q, pi and context action

active_lane.collision_rule: Do not revive the consumed Round-3 identity; any execution must use a new theorem/question identifier.

immediate_safe_actions: Draft the abstract lifting lemma and its two canonical counterexample families.
Build a primary-source novelty table for graph coverings, rewriting modulo congruence and liftability.
Separate the two bounded manuscripts from the new successor package so an adverse theorem cannot rewrite their claims.
forbidden_actions: Do not relabel quotient completeness as source completeness.
Do not edit the placeholder SHA256SUMS into an apparent release receipt.
Do not reuse accessed Round-3 outcomes as held-out evidence.
papers.journal_bar: A top-tier theory paper needs a clean equivalence or impossibility theorem, mechanized proof, minimal counterexamples, saturated nearest-work subtraction and a separately bound final manuscript.
papers.sibling_boundary: Owns realization/liftability of certificates; method-language expansion belongs to ORION-20.
